suggestions.title: Reactivate Instagram content strategy
suggestions.problem: Instagram reach is 0 for today, indicating no recent posts or algorithmic visibility
suggestions.root_cause: Likely gap in posting schedule or Instagram account inactivity; algorithm deprioritizes inactive accounts
suggestions.suggestion: Establish a consistent posting schedule of 3-4 times per week on Instagram. Create carousel posts featuring bakery/cafe discoveries with high-quality photos, location tags, and location stickers to increase discoverability
suggestions.expected_impact: Restore Instagram reach from 0 to 500-2000+ impressions daily; drive 15-25% of website traffic from Instagram within 4 weeks
suggestions.implementation_note: Post template: Day 1 (Mon/Wed): New bakery spotlight carousel (5-7 slides), Day 2 (Thu): User-generated content reels, Day 3 (Sat): Weekly top 3 picks. Include location tags, hashtags (8-15 relevant), and CTAs linking to website via bio link or sticker.

suggestions.title: Improve content relevance to reduce bounce sessions
suggestions.problem: 62.5% of sessions (5 out of 8 days) have 0-1 engaged sessions; Aug 18 had 5 sessions but 0 engaged
suggestions.root_cause: Website content may not match user search intent; landing pages lack clear CTAs or bakery/cafe details that answer user questions
suggestions.suggestion: Audit top landing pages and add micro-conversions: prominent 'Save Bakery' buttons, 'View on Map' CTAs, and quick-info cards (hours, address, specialty items) above the fold. A/B test landing page layouts prioritizing visual content over text
suggestions.expected_impact: Increase engaged session rate from ~40% to 60-70%; reduce bounce rate by 20-30%; improve average session duration
suggestions.implementation_note: Add sticky header with quick actions: <button>地図で見る</button> <button>お気に入り保存</button>. Place bakery info cards within first 300px of page load: { name, cuisine_type, address, hours, signature_item }

suggestions.title: Increase organic traffic volume through content marketing
suggestions.problem: Total weekly sessions are low (36 sessions across 6 days); average 6 sessions/day indicates minimal organic discovery
suggestions.root_cause: Limited SEO visibility; low keyword rankings for bakery/cafe discovery queries; insufficient content about regional bakeries and trending items
suggestions.suggestion: Create location-specific and trend-based content targeting long-tail keywords: blog posts like '〇〇駅周辺のクロワッサン専門店5選' or '2026年話題のペストリー店'. Optimize for local search and include schema markup for bakery listings
suggestions.expected_impact: Increase weekly sessions from 36 to 80-120 within 8 weeks; improve organic search traffic by 40-50%
suggestions.implementation_note: Publish 2 blog posts weekly with schema markup: { '@type': 'LocalBusiness', 'name': '', 'address': '', 'geo': { 'latitude': '', 'longitude': '' }, 'specialty': '' }. Target keywords with 100-500 monthly searches in ちるまる's regions.
